name: Crocs? Water Cannons? It's War!
description: After stumbling into a "dangerous area," you and Paimon run into a special engineer who's tinkering with a promising contraption...

dialogs.content: I never imagined that you two would follow the sound of the broadcast here, especially after being warned!
Pardon me, but this attraction isn't officially open to the public yet. Please wait a few minutes for me to make some final adjustments...
What are you planning?
Paimon heard words that sounded super scary! Water cannons! Must be that huge thing over there...
Whoa, it's scary just to look at!
Just what are you trying to do here!? We won't let you get away with it!
No, no, you misunderstand!
I'm Chatillon, head of project "Spino Blaster"! This project simulates naval battles, but much more fun and casual!
"Spino Blaster" is approved by Lady Idyia, so you know it's safe!
If you wish to verify the truth of that, please see this document signed by Lady Idyia herself.

The suspicious engineer offers proof in the form of official documents written in obtuse legalese, all with Idyia's distinct signature.\nThe margins even contain a few remarks and well-wishes from Idyia in her inimitable style...
So it's a project approved by Idyia... you scared us half to death!
So, what's the deal with the water cannons?
That's just a simplified nickname! Its full name is so long that I'm pretty sure most people would go for something shorter based on its appearance.
Anyway, its water bullets are completely harmless! At most, they might soak the guests standing near their target.
Some guests enjoy the sudden coolness from being splashed, but some hate how their clothes stick to their body afterward, and we don't want anyone to have a bad experience!
So if possible, I would like to post warning signs around the area.
Paimon didn't think you were so considerate, that's a great idea!
Now I'm curious...

It's called the Crocomorph Vortex-Based Crocodilian-Armored Heavy Naval Battleship-Style Recreational Water Blasting Cannon! The name accurately reflects both the appearance and its underlying principles!
Wow, you weren't kidding! Paimon can't even repeat it, much less understand it...
But just calling it a water cannon kinda misses the point, right? Why not call it a Crococannon?
The... the alliteration...
That's perfect! Simple and easy to remember, yet it captures the sound of shells whizzing by your eyes in a simulated naval battle! I love it!
Crococannon, fire away!
Crococannon bubbleball away!
Are you serious?
After all, not only do we have great chemistry, but you'll get to enjoy the one-of-a-kind fun!
Say, how about you two be the first to try out "Spino Blaster"?
The rules are simple. Adjust the Crococannon and hit balloon targets with bubbleballs to earn points! When you earn a high enough score, you can win prizes!
Well, after all this hype, Paimon kinda does want to see what it's like to use a Crococannon!
All right, count me in!
Perfect! Let me finish a few final adjustments, and then you can get started!
Enjoy yourselves!
Crococannon, open fi— water!
Paimon doesn't like being made fun of...
What's its full name?
Stop it, now!
